column1: # Manifold sync clips — the committed recipes (AUDIO_RESAMPLER_DESIGN.md §19.3, §19.9).
# One row per clip. Tab-separated: label, frame rate (exact rational), unit (frames per code step).
# The code is 23 / 29 / 31 / 37 steps between events, repeating (cycle 120 steps). `unit` scales a
# step in frames: 1 at ≤ 30 fps; 2 at 50 and 59.94, where 23 frames would be 0.46 / 0.38 s and the
# existing beep detector (avsync.beep_times) merges onsets closer than 0.5 s. With it, every interval
# at every rate is 0.77–1.54 s. Set it to 1 for the literal frame code.
# `cycles` is the BUNDLED clip's length in whole code cycles (cycle = 120 × unit frames, 4.0–5.0 s):
# 4 → 16–20 s, 16 events. A whole number of cycles is a whole number of frames AND of 48 kHz samples
# at every rate (a cycle is a multiple of 5 frames, and 5 frames is whole samples at 29.97 / 59.94),
# and the code runs on unbroken across the loop seam: the last event of a cycle is 37 steps before
# the next cycle's first, which is the clip's first event once the clip loops (§19.11). The ProRes
# masters are unchanged (60 × round(rate) frames; at 25 and 50 that is 12.5 cycles, so a master's
# loop seam breaks the code there — the bundled clips are the ones meant to loop).
